name: Hel
source:
An heir to the throne of Utgard and the eldest daughter.

The prodigal daughter who is considered to be the closest to the Throne.

Her skill at leading an army, her clever use of magic and tactics, and overall power surpasses the other heirs, and above all, her personal battle prowess is undisputed.

Even as a youth, she chose to stand on the front lines of the imperial army of her own will, and has fought countless battles to suppress riots within the demon realm. By the time Loki was born, she was already a prodigy who has been left in charge of a large part of the army.

She is a top-class demon warrior who controls the elements of water, wind, and lightning.

「Do your best to cling to life, as my tempest spear will blow away your very soul!」

Weapon names: Blikjandabol (scythe), Eljundir (jewel)
